title: Generalizing a family of scattered quadrinomials in $\mathbb{F}_{q^{2t}}[X]$
summary: In recent years, several efforts have focused on identifying new families of scattered polynomials. Currently, only three families in $\mathbb{F}_{q^n}[X]$ are known to exist for infinitely many values of $n$ and $q$: (i) pseudoregulus-type monomials, (ii) Lunardon-Polverino-type binomials, and (iii) a family of quadrinomials studied in a series of papers. In this work, we provide sufficient conditions under which these quadrinomials, denoted by $ψ_{m,h,s}$, are scattered. Our results both include and generalize those obtained in previous studies.
